224: R. Hamnuna the Elder, when he would come out from the river as Shabbat approached, would sit for a moment and raise his eyes, and was happy, and would say that he was sitting there in order to see the joy of the supernal angels – those ascending and those descending. And every Shabbat eve, a person sits in the world of souls. How fortunate is the one who knows the mysteries of their Master!
